<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 480" width="600" height="480">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="480" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- SALT BRIDGE (U-tube, drawn behind/between beakers) -->
  <path d="M 230 180 
           Q 230 110, 300 110 
           Q 370 110, 370 180" 
        fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Salt bridge inner hollow to make it look like a tube -->
  <path d="M 230 180 
           Q 230 120, 300 120 
           Q 370 120, 370 180" 
        fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- LEFT BEAKER (Zinc) -->
  <!-- Solution -->
  <path d="M 110 220 L 110 330 Q 110 340, 120 340 L 220 340 Q 230 340, 230 330 L 230 220 Z" fill="#eef2f5" stroke="none" />
  <!-- Liquid level line -->
  <line x1="110" y1="220" x2="230" y2="220" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <!-- Beaker glass walls -->
  <path d="M 100 160 L 100 335 Q 100 350, 115 350 L 225 350 Q 240 350, 240 335 L 240 160" 
        fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Beaker lip left -->
  <path d="M 95 160 L 105 160" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Beaker lip right -->
  <path d="M 235 160 L 245 160" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- RIGHT BEAKER (Copper) -->
  <!-- Solution -->
  <path d="M 370 220 L 370 330 Q 370 340, 380 340 L 480 340 Q 490 340, 490 330 L 490 220 Z" fill="#e0f0e0" stroke="none" />
  <!-- Liquid level line -->
  <line x1="370" y1="220" x2="490" y2="220" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <!-- Beaker glass walls -->
  <path d="M 360 160 L 360 335 Q 360 350, 375 350 L 485 350 Q 500 350, 500 335 L 500 160" 
        fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Beaker lip left -->
  <path d="M 355 160 L 365 160" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Beaker lip right -->
  <path d="M 495 160 L 505 160" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- ELECTRODES -->
  <!-- Zinc Electrode (Left) -->
  <rect x="150" y="130" width="20" height="150" fill="#dddddd" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Copper Electrode (Right) -->
  <rect x="410" y="130" width="20" height="150" fill="#cc8866" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- EXTERNAL CIRCUIT / WIRES -->
  <!-- Left wire from zinc electrode up to voltmeter -->
  <polyline points="160,130 160,80 260,80" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <!-- Right wire from copper electrode up to voltmeter -->
  <polyline points="420,130 420,80 340,80" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2.5" />

  <!-- VOLTMETER -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="80" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="300" y="88" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">V</text>

  <!-- LABELS & TEXT (Sans-serif, exam style) -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <!-- Electrodes -->
    <text x="140" y="125" text-anchor="end">zinc</text>
    <text x="440" y="125" text-anchor="start">copper</text>

    <!-- Solutions -->
    <text x="170" y="270" text-anchor="middle">1.0 mol dm⁻³</text>
    <text x="170" y="290" text-anchor="middle">ZnSO₄(aq)</text>

    <text x="430" y="270" text-anchor="middle">1.0 mol dm⁻³</text>
    <text x="430" y="290" text-anchor="middle">CuSO₄(aq)</text>

    <!-- Salt bridge label with pointer line -->
    <text x="300" y="150" text-anchor="middle">salt bridge</text>
    <line x1="300" y1="135" x2="300" y2="120" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <polygon points="300,135 296,127 304,127" fill="#222222" />

    <!-- Caption -->
    <text x="300" y="420" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 6.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
